classes.name: CharacterBody2D
classes.brief: A 2D physics body specialized for characters moved by script.
classes.description: CharacterBody2D is for implementing bodies that are controlled via script. It is not affected by physics unless move_and_slide is called. Replaces the Godot 3 KinematicBody2D.

methods.name: move_and_slide
methods.description: Moves the body using velocity. Auto-slides along walls and floors. Use velocity (Vector2 property) to control motion; do not pass a vector argument as in Godot 3.

methods.name: is_on_floor
methods.description: Returns true if the body collided with the floor on the last call to move_and_slide.

methods.name: is_on_wall
methods.description: Returns true if the body collided with a wall on the last call to move_and_slide.

methods.name: get_floor_normal
methods.description: Returns the collision normal of the floor at the last collision point.

properties.name: velocity
properties.description: Current velocity. Set this, then call move_and_slide.

properties.name: floor_snap_length
properties.description: How far below the body the floor snap raycast extends. Replaces Godot 3 move_and_slide_with_snap.

properties.name: up_direction
properties.description: Used to determine what counts as 'floor' vs 'wall'.

classes.name: Area2D
classes.brief: A 2D area that detects bodies and other areas entering or exiting it.
classes.description: Area2D is most commonly used for triggers, damage zones, pickups, and detection ranges. Connect to body_entered / area_entered signals instead of overriding _physics_process.

methods.name: get_overlapping_bodies
methods.description: Returns all PhysicsBody2D and TileMap nodes currently overlapping.

signals.name: body_entered
signals.description: Emitted when a PhysicsBody2D or TileMap enters this Area2D.

signals.name: body_exited
signals.description: Emitted when a PhysicsBody2D or TileMap exits this Area2D.

signals.name: area_entered
signals.description: Emitted when another Area2D enters this Area2D.

signals.name: area_exited
signals.description: Emitted when another Area2D exits this Area2D.

properties.name: monitoring
properties.description: If true, this area can detect bodies/areas entering and exiting.

properties.name: monitorable
properties.description: If true, other monitoring areas can detect this one.

classes.name: AnimationPlayer
classes.brief: A node that plays back animations from an AnimationLibrary.
classes.description: In Godot 4, animations are stored in AnimationLibrary resources attached to the AnimationPlayer. The 'animation_finished' signal replaces Godot 3's 'animation_finished(name)' — the argument is the same but the connection syntax is the modern Callable form.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Plays the animation with the given name (or the current one if empty).

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops playback. If keep_state is true, the current frame is preserved.

methods.name: queue
methods.description: Queues an animation to play after the current one finishes.

signals.name: animation_finished
signals.description: Emitted when an animation finishes naturally. Connect with a Callable: anim_player.animation_finished.connect(_on_anim_finished)

properties.name: current_animation
properties.description: The name of the currently playing animation.
